ValidationRule.description: Admin Toolkit HARD fixture: the field three times, inside nested AND / OR / IF. Never fires. Safe to delete.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Name = "SFTK_NEVER_FIRES", OR( ISBLANK(SFTK_Pkg_Tag__c), LEN(SFTK_Pkg_Tag__c) > 5 ), IF( BEGINS(SFTK_Pkg_Tag__c, "x"), TRUE, CONTAINS(Name, "y") ) )
